axes: glTF +Y up, 1 unit = 1 m. Creature faces glTF +Z (Blender -Y), ground contact at y = 0; the engine turns it with yaw(angle) * rot_y(PI).
variant_rule: one file per look; identical GF_Swarm_v1, sockets and clip suffixes; clips are named {file_stem}_{clip}. Pick one of variant_set per spawn (cinderling.glb alone is complete).
move_note: one hop per move@loop cycle: play it at speed / move_cycle_m cycles per second (row speed 3.2 m/s -> about 3.8 hops/s). The hop is in place; root only lifts (0.13 m apex).

clip_notes.windup: squash low, rear back, the lid (head) opens over the white-hot maw; ends on the loaded pose
clip_notes.attack: a pounce-chomp: leaps ~0.4 m forward in place-relative root motion, the lid snaps shut at frame 5 (the contact hit), lands and returns to rest
clip_notes.death: swells, the lid bursts off and falls behind, the growth breaks away, the coal slumps and crumbles to ash (scale 0.02, held); burst / ember VFX at fx_core are the engine's
clip_notes.spawn: extra clip for Summon (the Slag King's furnace): pops from a curled ember to full size

rig_note: GF_Swarm_v1: body = jaw half + maw bowl (squash/stretch by scale, base kept on the ground); head = the lid hinged at the back (rotate -X opens the mouth); tail = the obsidian growth; legs_a / legs_b unweighted (a blob has no legs)
